expectedBehavior.prompt: Explore the test directory and report which files cover routing policy.

notes: This codebase has no actor classifier yet (planned for the actor-classification phase). At the /v1/messages wire layer a subagent's fresh request is structurally identical to a main fresh request: tools present, last message is user text. The only thing that currently distinguishes it is conversationKey, which hashes session id plus first-message text and so differs from the main conversation's key. A real capture is needed before any field-level actor signal can be asserted; see overview blocker B-002.
